name: Path B — Manual JD Paste (Ranjeet) FIXED

parameters.body:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'llama3.2', prompt: 'You are a JD parser. Extract structured information from the job description below.

Return ONLY valid JSON — no preamble, no markdown, no explanation.

Output schema:
{
  "required_skills": ["string"],
  "preferred_skills": ["string"],
  "years_experience": "string",
  "seniority_level": "string",
  "key_responsibilities": ["string"],
  "ats_keywords": ["string"],
  "certifications_required": ["string"],
  "domain": "string"
}

Job Title: ' + $json.title + '
Company: ' + $json.company + '

Job Description:
' + $json.jd_text, stream: false }) }}

- ITIL 4 · SIAM · ServiceNow ITSM/CMDB · Change Management
- Multi-vendor governance · SLA/KPI management · P&L governance
- Agentic AI (n8n, Ollama, Claude Code, Docker) · Workflow automation
- Linux/systemd/UFW · PostgreSQL · n8n · Predictive analytics

Experience (reverse-chron):
1. IT Solutions / Open Mind Lab — Enterprise IT Ops & Automation Lead (Mar 2023–Present)
2. TCS — ServiceNow Catalog Specialist (May 2022–May 2023)
3. TCS — Shell Governance Leader (Mar 2020–May 2022) — SIAM framework, multi-vendor SLA governance
4. TCS — Cargill EMEA Resource Manager (Feb 2019–Mar 2020) — 900+ member workforce, EMEA capacity
5. TCS — Change Management Analyst (Feb 2018–Feb 2019)
6. TCS — Telstra Program Manager (Aug 2015–Feb 2018)

Key Achievements:
- Reduced critical downtime 30% via predictive analytics at Shell
- Cleared 12-month backlog in 90 days at Telstra
- Optimised 900+ member workforce for Cargill EMEA

Certifications: ITIL Foundation (x2)
In Progress: PSM I · TOGAF Foundation

--- JOB TO SCORE ---
Title: ' + $json.title + '
Company: ' + $json.company + '
Required Skills: ' + JSON.stringify($json.jd_parsed.required_skills) + '
Preferred Skills: ' + JSON.stringify($json.jd_parsed.preferred_skills) + '
ATS Keywords: ' + JSON.stringify($json.jd_parsed.ats_keywords) + '
Seniority: ' + $json.jd_parsed.seniority_level + '

Certifications Required: ' + JSON.stringify($json.jd_parsed.certifications_required) + '
Key Responsibilities: ' + JSON.stringify($json.jd_parsed.key_responsibilities) + '

--- OUTPUT SCHEMA ---
{
  "score": 0,
  "match_strengths": ["string"],
  "skill_gaps": ["string"],
  "recommended_title_tweak": "string",
  "priority": "high | medium | low",
  "apply_recommended": true
}' }] }) }}
